title: Appsync to Amazon EventBridge using Appsync Datasource
description: This pattern connects AppSync to EventBridge directly using AppSync Datasource

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how to integrate Amazon EventBridge with AWS Appsync.
AWS AppSync can publish events to EventBridge as a datasource. It uses resolver functions for the requests and responses to create the custom events.
This pattern deploys one AWS Appsync API, one custom EventBus, and one AppSync Javascript resolver function.
